headline: Turkey Capital Markets Board Raises Investor Thresholds and Extends Fund Deadlines
summary: Türkiye's Capital Markets Board (SPK) raised the financial qualification thresholds for qualified investors. The regulator also extended compliance deadlines for investment funds to January 31, 2027.
why: The Capital Markets Board of Türkiye is the state regulatory agency responsible for overseeing securities markets and institutional funds in Türkiye.
